title: Phase 2: Mounded Cultivation during the Mid Holocene
version: Ten Thousand Years of Cultivation at Kuk Swamp, Terra Australis 46, chapter 12, DOI 10.22459/TA46.07.2017.12
lineage: Excavation synthesis including both campaigns; phytolith evidence shares the team and material described in chapter 10 and earlier papers. The inference about crop placement is distinct from the measurement of structures. Inspected PDF SHA-256 b4dea3803f12817bdb0ec1173fd99758caa14cc36723d889e308bbee1bde3acb.

passages.note: Reports early dated fills, the preserved palaeosurface, and detail from the 1970s and 1998–1999 campaigns.

Interprets Musaceae concentrations in early palaeosurface features as evidence for the planting of bananas in mounded plots. The interpretation of raised ground for moisture-intolerant plants also uses diatom evidence.
